test_provider_env_blocklist_stripped: test that OPENAI_BASE_URL and other provider env vars are stripped from subprocess environment
test_registry_derived_vars_stripped: test that provider registry vars like ANTHROPIC_TOKEN and ZAI_API_KEY are blocked from subprocess env
test_tool_gateway_vars_stripped: test that tool and gateway secrets like TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and SLACK_APP_TOKEN are blocked from subprocess env
test_safe_vars_preserved: test that standard env vars like PATH, HOME, and USER are preserved in subprocess environment
test_force_prefix_passes_blocked_var: test that _HERMES_FORCE_ prefix in self.env allows a blocked var to be passed to subprocess
